5 تجللّٰهُ He took the greater, main, principal, or chief, part of it; the main, gross, mass, or bulk, of it; (S, K;) as also ↓ اجتلّهُ (K) and ↓ تجالّهُ . (Ibn-'Abbád, K. [In the CK, in the explanation of the second and third of these verbs, جِلَالَهُ is erroneously put for جُلَالَهُ.]) ―
-b2- See also 2. ―
-b3- [Hence,] He sat upon him; namely, a horse. (K,) And تجلّل الفَحْلُ النَّاقَةَ (S and K in art. دأم) The stallion-camel mounted the she-camel. (TA in that art.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
